results.title: All original nilpotent layers have evaluated heat responses
results.statement: For the original coefficient flag F^jA, t^(-j)T_t converges to p_(2j) conjugate(f_j)g_j, with p_(2j) the exact positive Hermite root moment. The next coefficient is 2j(2d-c^2)p_(2j)+4j(2j-1)c^2p_(2j-2). The original socle lift beta(i xi/2)^(m-1) is evaluated through its next order. The ramified separated boundary algebra keeps the full polynomial and has cokernel sum O_u/(u^j).

results.title: The actual heat equation makes integral collision monodromy regular
results.statement: The full actual heat branches yield a convergent F(t,y)=y+tB(t,y) and an exact original-coordinate substitution matrix T with T(0)=I. The collision monodromy is T^(-1)diag((-1)^k)T over C{t}; hence (A+M_A A)/A=0 at every actual multiplicity. The full original unit transformation and first logarithmic-unit variation are evaluated.

results.title: Connection exponents and supported projections retain the exact arithmetic defect
results.statement: The original connection has residue diag(k/2); its trace-residue difference from the integral-closure lattice is floor((m-1)^2/4), exactly the conductor index. The two supported parity projections compose to kappa(a,lambda)=(0,lambda), preserving every zero-support label. The synchronized parity module has a proved semiring product. Applied to the positive eight-state collision algebra, the projection retains its length-four local algebra, has multiplication defect (0,9d_xd_y,0), and changes the full spectrum only by merging the two reduced S=±3 points.
